main_text.p: Ebn Sahl أبو الحسين[?] AlSufi AlRazi. Obiit anno H. 376 natus annos 85. Gregor. AlSufi autem rigidiorem Sufiorum disciplinam amplexum denotat, quiSharholbus inde juxta non paucos appellatio صوفيون[?] Tasawof.quòd laneis utantur vestibus ut olim Prophetæ, vel ut عباد الله[?] Ascetæ & qui Monasteriis inclusi vivunt, (ut loquitur AlZamachsharius) quamvis minùs arridèat Illustrissimo Scaligero hæc nominis ratio, ut ex his ipsius verbis, l.5. deemend: temp. patet, ubi de Persarum Regibus loquitur: Hodie vocamus Reges illos Sofi, quia صفي[?] Arabicè significat puræ religionis hominem & in melius reformatum, cujusmodi suam religionem esse contendunt, &c. Quod quidam Sofi à flocco lanæ dictum volunt, hoc levius est ipso flocco lanæ. Hæc magnus ille vir: Ut autem quid statuendum sit judicet æquus lector, non gravabimur quæ ipsi Arabes de hac appellatione tradant, pluribus apponere. Nomen est, teste AlMakrizio, Mohammedanû prisci ignorum, nec multò ante annum Hejræ 200. idque glisecentibus tunc temporis lectis & hæresibus, natum, quo se à cæteris distingui volebant qui religiosius majorum vestigiis insisterent, ita tamen ut من حيث[?] juxta Arabifmi canones, quare ita appellati sint, haud facile sit dijudicare. Qui à صوف[?] Suf, lana, vel vestibus laneis dictum volunt AlSufi, faventes habent Grammaticorum regulas alii tamen à صفة[?] Soffah porticu quadam juxta templum Medinæ à Mohammede constructum, ubi pauperes aliquot ex ipsius afleclis quibus ædes propriæ non essent, abdicata rerum mundanarum curâ, diversari

page.notes: Left margin: two keyword notes, "Sharhol" and "Tasawof.", are placed beside the lines where they stand; their exact line positions are approximate. The Arabic words are copied from a small, low-resolution scan and are only partly legible, so every Arabic word is marked [?]; the Arabic readings in the text are best guesses and should be checked against the scan. The word before "Sofi" and the phrase before "Arabicè" are uncertain. "Gregor." is a printed source reference, kept as printed. Printing errors left as printed: "Arabifmi", "deemend", "cflent" (read as "essent"), "afleclis", "Mohammede". "diverfari" is the last line of text, not a catchword, because nothing is printed below it. A Google watermark at the bottom right is excluded.
